newsitem.title: GERMANY: Fragile sterling good news for Europe cocoa buyers.
newsitem.headline: Fragile sterling good news for Europe cocoa buyers.

text.p: Chocolate manufacturers in Germany and the Netherlands are benefitting from the post-election slide in sterling as it reduces cocoa bean prices in mark and guilders, German trader Albrecht & Dill said.
A&D's weekly cocoa market report on Friday said this created "attractive purchasing opportunities" for the industry.
Consumers had taken some cover for the second half of 1997 and were likely to stay around, it said.
The Labour party's landslide victory in the British general election prompted profit-taking in sterling.
Cocoa supply fundamentals also look comfortable, which has brought lower futures levels.
The German industry has not bought large quantities of raw materials in months and consumers need sizeable cover, traders have said.
